release_notes:
## 1.0.0 (2026-10-30)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* a fault in a gateway answer, a menu press or the reads thread no longer crashes YouTube, and Original caption loads when another language makes it available ([8d6999f](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/8d6999f992679a54f3fa308ea1961d19e31db875))
* account reads started before a sign-out or the preview's stand-in are left, a return confirms a payment once, Sign in greys its rows while the code is made, and the browser opens without sending YouTube to picture-in-picture ([26a34c0](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/26a34c089b64d8f80439499598149911fe5fe5d0))
* Settings sample stands in when nothing is on screen yet or no translation is on, as in the extension ([51328ca](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/51328caeeec3c5af6675f03027ae3624d9e58db2))
* Subtitles at the size of YouTube's own captions, in portrait and fullscreen ([c68109d](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/c68109d94df1827b6668375ee1dd839438db3fb6))
* TalkBack announces Jimaku's sheet as YouTube's, with its drag handle, and reads Settings and every button as a button ([d82686d](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/d82686df3cc2c06a808c822c2a006ac3d99fe4f2))
* TalkBack reads out a message that appears as the menu's sheet closes (youtube-app-making 4.8) ([9717832](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/971783210a2f09dc5e740a8097b865108269314f))
* what the viewer presses while a video is looked up stays their choice, and no reading message is left behind ([9fad71d](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/9fad71d62b50798de627160596e80de9a5429b9a))

### ✨ New Features

* a one-time hint points at Jimaku's button on the first video after a fresh install, goes with YouTube's controls, closes with × or the button, and is announced politely to TalkBack ([e36cc05](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/e36cc0591b0ecee69da1a1d6a850f84c0f472672))
* Captions dragged by their grip while Settings is open, within the extension's reach ([4d851c0](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/4d851c0c586508b6b9f69394167ae488a210588a))
* Jimaku button and menu in the player, in YouTube's own sheets ([017b7fe](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/017b7fe431d348c227c40207ca1fda0c2d92ce49))
* Jimaku subtitles over the YouTube player, through Morphe's add-on API ([bf12084](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/bf120846111c7a1871f645312f8ef861ccc70f6a))
* Settings slides to the right edge in fullscreen, with the captions moving in beside it ([efa5bea](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/efa5bea31ac37fae41cb1a5eb15c550a03279d01))
* sign in on jimaku.app, the Premium switch with your minutes, and Account with the launch offer, buying and signing out ([54a9436](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/54a94360b72d58742c23b40807a94ea43e15e6fa))
* Standard and Generate in the app as in the extension, with progress, Stop and the job picked up again (youtube-app-making 4.1-4.7) ([b68ae19](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/b68ae190ed082492e998258336d0cdd8eeb19d0a))
* the extension's message, the button's bar and "!", questions in place and Other languages' search (youtube-app-making 3.1–3.4) ([279b665](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/279b66502891a347e080ac560643e037a00443a4))
* The extension's whole menu model in Java, run on its shared menu cases; step 2's menu reads it signed out from the cache ([38159be](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/38159bec967734aeede1a72c97c1ba3e46b5ea9b))
* YouTube 21.20.405 declared, checked on a phone with Morphe's patches ([91d8c06](https://github.com/1-Felix/jimaku-patches/commit/91d8c06e5ae2d1a47d13605153da74a6d17356ac))
